svg.text: INF1103 Lab 9 — UML Class Diagram (Strategy and Factory patterns)
+ Product(product_id: String, name: String, price: Float,
name: String, price: Float, stock: Integer,
Visibility: − private + public italics / {abstract} = abstract underlined = static / class-level [0..*] = collection, [0..1] = optional (may be none)
Relationships: plain solid line = association hollow diamond = aggregation (at the whole) filled diamond = composition (at the whole)
solid line + hollow triangle = inheritance (child → parent) dashed line + hollow triangle = interface realisation dashed arrow «creates» = dependency
Patterns: Strategy = Order uses one DiscountStrategy (shareable, swappable with set_discount) Factory = ProductFactory creates Products but does not store them
